name: Frida Berenbruch
original_name: フリーダ＝ベーレンブルッフ
source:
A Furth woman, secretary to the major.
Her rank is lieutenant.

In contrast to her intelligent and cold appearance, she has a voluptuous body and exudes a somewhat seductive aura.

Born into a family of military men, she grew up dreaming of one day inheriting the family business, but was devastated when she found out that she could not inherit the family business because she was a woman.

Around that time, she met the major (still a captain at the time), and when she learned that he was burning with ambition, she used the backing of the Berenbruch family to somehow get him to promote her as secretary, and as a result of contributing to the major's promotion, she achieved her current position.


[Translated from [url=https://www.turumiku.jp/product/gouhou/#character05]the official site[/url]]
